understanding: Verify IIR bits 3-1 report highest priority pending interrupt with documented source and reset control and bit0 pending indication, and every IIR read returns bits 7-6 as 1 and bits 5-4 as 0, after t_ier_iir_en settles enables; fixed-bits assertion and cover are quick-test temporary inferred checks backed by documented field definitions.
preconditions: Dependency t_ier_iir_en settled: IER enables programmed via wishbone_bus with normal registers accessed and sources idle before IIR priority checks
DUT in DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 FIFO-only compatible build with UART_ADDR_WIDTH 3 and UART_DATA_WIDTH 8; use symbolic IIR address from documented address 2 without assuming literal wb_adr_i encoding
Apply the clock and reset with symbolic polarity; expect IIR reset value C1h after reset

wishbone_bus owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i and observes wb_dat_o wb_ack_o; uart_interrupt uses custom monitor to observe int_o with symbolic polarity; serial_data and modem_control_if own stimulus inputs with symbolic idle tie_offs
Serial data_bits parity stop_bits bit_cycles track LCR programming symbolically; wishbone_bus configuration writes agree with serial_data driver and monitor settings
stimulus_steps: STAGE bringup: SPAWN wishbone_bus IIR read sequence to SAMPLE reset value and fixed bits; WAIT for read completion
STAGE line_status: SPAWN serial_data error-frame stimulus to create Receiver Line Status; SPAWN wishbone_bus IIR polls to SAMPLE 011; SPAWN wishbone_bus LSR read for reset control
STAGE rx_available_timeout: SPAWN serial_data burst and idle gap to create 010 and 110; SPAWN wishbone_bus IIR polls plus RBR reads to SAMPLE codes and exercise FIFO-below-trigger and RBR-read resets
STAGE thre_modem: SPAWN wishbone_bus THR write plus IIR poll to create and SAMPLE 001; SPAWN modem_control_if delta stimulus plus wishbone_bus MSR read to create and SAMPLE 000

STAGE priority_overlap: SPAWN combined serial_data plus modem_control_if plus THR-empty sources; SPAWN wishbone_bus IIR polls to SAMPLE highest-priority code with 011 over 010 and 110 over 001 over 000
STAGE fixed_bits_soak: SPAWN wishbone_bus back-to-back IIR reads across all stages to SAMPLE bits 7-6 and 5-4 on every read
check_steps: COMPARE observed IIR bits 3-1 against active source set: EXPECT 011 line-status, 010 data-available, 110 timeout, 001 THRE-empty, 000 modem-status with highest priority winning
COMPARE IIR bit0: EXPECT 0 when any source pending else 1 consistent with int_o observed via uart_interrupt custom monitor
COMPARE every IIR read data: EXPECT bits 7-6 equal 1 and bits 5-4 equal 0
COMPARE reset controls via follow-up IIR poll: EXPECT LSR read clears 011, FIFO below trigger clears 010, RBR read clears 110, THR write or IIR read clears 001, MSR read clears 000
COMPARE post-reset IIR: EXPECT C1h with fixed bits intact and no-pending indication
coverage_steps: SAMPLE pending and code via dedicated subscriber tapping wishbone_bus IIR read monitor: pending versus no-pending, 000 modem-status, 001 THRE-empty, 010 rx-data, 110 timeout, 011 line-status
SAMPLE fixed compatibility bits on every IIR read via dedicated subscriber tapping wishbone_bus monitor; drivers never supply coverage events
SAMPLE reset-control correlations: read LSR, FIFO below trigger, read RBR, write THR or read IIR, read MSR versus IIR code change
completion: WAIT all spawned wishbone_bus serial_data modem_control_if children complete OR UNTIL TESTBENCH request_timeout_cycles expires as operational limit only, not DUT timing
DRAIN wishbone_bus and uart_interrupt monitors for drain_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limit then close virtual sequence
CLEANUP return wishbone_bus to idle via driver, release sequencer handles, leave serial_data and modem_control_if idle; virtual sequence spawns only, no VIFs or delays

facts.statement: IIR retrieves current highest priority pending interrupt.
facts.quote: The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending

facts.statement: IIR is address 2 width 8 access R for interrupt information.
facts.quote: Interrupt Identification 2 8 R Get interrupt information

facts.statement: IIR bit0 is 0 when interrupt pending.
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR bit0 is 1 when no interrupt pending.
IIR code 011 is 1st priority Receiver Line Status.
IIR code 010 is 2nd priority Receiver Data available.
IIR code 110 is 2nd priority Timeout indication.
IIR code 001 is 3rd priority Transmitter Holding Register empty.
IIR code 000 is 4th priority Modem Status for CTS DSR RI or DCD.
facts.quote: 0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD.

facts.statement: IIR bits 7-6 are logic 1 for compatibility.
facts.quote: Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: Receiver Line Status reset is reading Line Status Register.
Receiver Data available reset is FIFO drops below trigger level.
Timeout reset is reading Receiver Buffer Register.
